depth_justification: The regulatory mapping is correct and precise for a Class IIa SaMD (Notified Body, clinical evaluation under MDR Art. 61, IEC 62304, ISO 14971, ISO 13485, MDCG 2019-11/2020-1, Annex VIII, PMS/PSUR/PMCF, Art. 83-86), but it is severely undermined by the identical questions 6-10 block being repeated verbatim five times with zero new information, which caps depth.
actionability_justification: Gives concrete, implementable steps with named standards and exact artifacts (engage a Notified Body, build the technical file per Annex VIII, clinical evaluation report + CIP, IEC 62304 SDLC with test plans/reports, ISO 14971 risk file, ISO 13485 QMS, PMS plan with PSUR + PMCF, incident logs per Art. 83-86) and closes with the requested severity-grouped report plus a next-steps checklist.
salient_examples: Class IIa SaMD must undergo clinical evaluation ... under MDR Article 61 ... include CIP if necessary
Ensure your software development lifecycle (SDLC) includes software validation ... in line with IEC 62304
6. Is a Notified Body required ... (questions 6-10 block repeated verbatim 5 times)
High Severity Risks | [P1.D1] ... Rule 11 ... MDCG 2019-11 | [P2.D1] Clinical evidence ... Article 61 | [P4.D5] PMS ... Article 83-86
